components.name: kubectl client
components.description: Reads kubeconfig, discovers API resources and sends requests

components.name: API server
components.description: Front door; authentication, authorization, admission and API operations

components.name: etcd
components.description: Durable backing store for cluster API objects

components.name: Scheduler
components.description: Binds unscheduled Pods to eligible nodes

components.name: Worker kubelet
components.description: Watches assigned Pods and manages node lifecycle

components.name: Container runtime
components.description: CRI implementation pulls images and starts containers

components.name: Pod network
components.description: CNI provides Pod connectivity; Service dataplane routes traffic

operational_steps: kubectl loads kubeconfig and selects context
Client discovers the target API resource
Authorization and admission policy checks run
API server validates and persists API objects
Networking and readiness make workloads reachable
failure_checkpoint: API server unavailable or etcd unhealthy
recovery_path: Check control-plane health and API endpoint reachability; restore control-plane dependencies before retrying workloads.
